# Loci retrieval repair and corrected delivery evidence — 14 September 2026

W1.8.4.1 reconciled eight retained binding/checkpoint intervals exactly: provider usage deltas, cumulative totals, output bytes, operations and interval hashes agree. Binding median input is 2.7236 times baseline; uncached input is 1.7380 times baseline. Provider responses grew from 6.5 to 12.5 and contexts also grew. These are descriptive measurements, not dollar costs, causal shares or demonstrated savings.

The supported CaptureCommandResultOptions -> WorkContextBinding edge and full import/barrel/definition/control proof already existed. Ownership expansion packed incidental members and owner relationships before selected-anchor semantics, exhausting the result budget. W1.8.4.2 now gives direct anchor semantics priority and explicit-anchor pairs priority before neighbor truncation. Fresh deterministic fixed-source replay delivers the expected proof for options and pair requests at 16,091 and 16,019 output bytes within the unchanged 16,384-byte ceiling. Native ownership, complete atomic proof and both browser/renderer call directions remain. Broad binding retrieval remains bounded without a guarantee for one consumer. All 638 fixed source files remain unchanged.

Correction to the earlier current Brain orientation: the frozen observer undercounted complete JSON-line results and applied a turn-wide truncation warning too broadly. Its credited six-of-eight graph deliveries are historical computed scores, not a complete account of actual clipping. Run 21 has five exact retrievals, one clipped retrieval and one exact read; run 17 has intact retrieval/read/error values around one clipped retrieve. Run 20 first discarded structuredContent by printing the empty content field, then repeated; identical native invocations remain ambiguous because trusted nested-to-outer identity is unavailable.

W1.8.4.3 adds a supplementary strict exact JSON-line/whole-block observer with original output references and UTF-8 byte spans. It preserves original observations, scores and ambiguity, rejects malformed/quoted/partial matches, and applies clipping only through locally aligned fragments that remain unproven. Loci cannot control arbitrary aggregate host caps or recover a result discarded by caller code. No marker, projection, locator codec or agent graph-choice guidance is selected as a repair.

Source acceptance: 16 retrieval, 47 normal MCP/server and nine further normal acceptance checks pass; final delivery supplement tests pass 19/19 (earlier adjacent suite 61/61). Primary review corrected numeric-equivalence invocation ambiguity and restored whole-block compatibility before adoption. All 45 frozen input hashes are unchanged.

W1.8.4.1/.2/.3 are complete. W1.8.4.4 remains open: the actual-host options request still equals the pre-repair frozen primary MCP line 5297 result (16,373 bytes, three relationships, no binding edge, valid source spans). The long-lived host has not loaded the repair; restart is required before repaired actual-host acceptance. Standalone source tests do not replace activation evidence.

The Objective remains in Implementation with ordinary correctness and cost acceptance unresolved. The negative frozen comparison, strict answer misses and 2.72x token result remain. No new provider attempts were run and no additional campaign is selected. A future comparison needs an explicit bounded selection and a separate pre-outcome freeze; no token-saving or causal answer-benefit claim is made.

Evidence: /Users/brummerv/loci/docs/reviews/2026-09-14-normal-graph-repair-diagnosis.md; .scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/diagnosis/{token-diagnosis,selection-repair-report,delivery-supplement-report}.md; diagnosis/{selection-repair-replay,repair-host-activation-check}.json; benchmarks/ordinary_adoption_delivery_v3.py; canonical Manifest ordinary graph-adoption Objective. No private raw runtime intervals were copied into Brain.
